issues: The designer's ui_flow.json primary flow fails at the backup step: filling 'Backup passphrase' and 'Confirm passphrase' with "securepass123" and clicking 'Create backup' never shows 'Backup ready to share' (reproduced in static validation at both phone and desktop sizes; the static check output quotes the exact failing text). Root cause: BackupPassphraseScreen.tsx's validatePassphrase() requires at least 3 of 4 character classes (upper, lower, digit, symbol), but "securepass123" only satisfies 2 (lower + digit), so create() returns the validation error and setBackupDone(true) is never reached, leaving the success message un-rendered. Since ui_flow.json is read-only and uses this exact passphrase, the app's validation rule must be relaxed (e.g., require only a minimum length, as the DESIGN.md spec states: "Passphrases must match and be at least 8 characters" — no character-class requirement is mentioned in DESIGN.md) so that "securepass123" passes and the backup flow completes to show 'Backup ready to share'.
feedback: Core logic, encryption, models, and acceptance tests all look solid, but the mandatory designer UI flow (which must pass at both phone and desktop sizes per the static validation gate) breaks at the backup step because of an overly strict passphrase policy that rejects the exact passphrase the flow test uses. Please loosen the passphrase validation in BackupPassphraseScreen.tsx to match DESIGN.md's stated requirement (minimum 8 characters, matching confirmation) so 'securepass123' is accepted and the flow can reach 'Backup ready to share', then re-run the ui_flow.json check to confirm steps 61 and beyond (restore, delete) still pass end-to-end.
